item.title: LA firefighter says he warned brush fire wasn't out before massive blaze ignited
item.description: A Los Angeles firefighter testified in a newly released deposition that he told colleagues the ground was still smoldering from a brush fire days before authorities say it reignited into the most destructive blaze in city history.

item.title: Local Girl Scout troop aims to give back with cookie sales
item.description: It's Girl Scout cookie season, a familiar tradition that teaches young girls responsibility, teamwork and goal-setting. But one local troop is taking those lessons a step further.

item.title: Nine hospitalized after mass shooting at Cincinnati concert venue
item.description: At least nine people were hospitalized after a shooting at a Cincinnati, Ohio, nightclub and concert venue early Sunday morning.

item.title: Dispatch: Dalton Twp. autobody shop burns in fire
item.description: An autobody shop in Dalton Township is burning, causing first responders to shut down a stretch of Holton Road, officials say.

item.title: 'Big moment': Iranian student reacts to attacks
item.description: An Iranian doctorate student at Michigan State University is breathing a sigh of relief after Iran was attacked by Israel and the United States.

item.title: Deputies: Downed power lines leaves street closed in Jenison
item.description: Part of a road was closed in Jenison Saturday night after a truck hit a power pole and knocked down multiple lines, deputies say.

item.title: Remembering Charles King: A forgotten automotive pioneer
item.description: Friday will mark 130 years since the first automobile went for a test drive in Detroit — and no, it didn't belong to Henry Ford.

item.title: No one hurt when MSP trooper was rear-ended on I-96
item.description: Police are warning drivers to slow down after a state trooper’s cruiser was rear-ended early Sunday.

item.title: In Grand Rapids, group protests U.S. intervention in Iran
item.description: Protests are taking place across the country in response to U.S. and Israeli military strikes in Iran, including in Grand Rapids, where Palestine Solidarity Grand Rapids held an emergency anti-war rally downtown.

item.title: US and Israel pound Iran as Trump signals willingness to talk to new leaders after Khamenei's death
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — The U.S. and Israel pounded targets across Iran on Sunday, dropping massive bombs on its ballistic missile sites and wiping out warships as part of an intensifying military campaign following the killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
